document.name: Bushwick H.O.P.E — Family Enrichment Center
document.description:
Bushwick H.O.P.E. (Honoring Our People Equally) is a Bushwick Family Enrichment Center at 959 Madison Street in Brooklyn. Its official site describes a welcoming, community-based space designed to support and strengthen families through resources, offerings, and activities, with a mission to create a safe, inclusive place where families build connections and thrive together.

The official About Us and Offerings pages say Family Enrichment Centers are walk-in family-centered spaces where activities are co-designed with community members, and that Bushwick H.O.P.E offerings include gatherings, activities, events, workshops, self-help groups, and fun community events for children, youth, and families. The center also highlights chances for neighbors to connect over snacks or coffee and seek support and resources.

Sources: https://www.bushwickhope.org/ https://www.bushwickhope.org/about-us https://www.bushwickhope.org/offerings https://www.bushwickhope.org/gallery
